data.desc: GBLI is a publicly traded holding company with a diversified portfolio of property and casualty insurance-related operating companies, organized in three groups: Katalyx Holdings LLC Four agencies that source, underwrite and service primary and assumed reinsurance business: Penn-America Insurance Services, LLC; Valyn Re LLC; J.H. Ferguson & Associates, LLC (including Vacant Express); and Collectibles Insurance Services, LLC. Two specialized insurance service businesses: Sayata, an AI-enabled digital marketplace and agency for small commercial insurance; and Liberty Insurance Adjustment Agency, Inc., which evaluates and adjusts claims and provides related services. Belmont Holdings GX, Inc. Five statutory insurance carriers, each rated 'A' (Excellent) by AM Best: Penn-America Insurance Company, United National Insurance Company, Penn-Patriot Insurance Company, Diamond State Insurance Company and Penn-Star Insurance Company. Kaleidoscope Insurance Technologies, Inc.
